reason: The hypothesis transfers the W alloying approach from AlCoCrFeNi coatings (P19, P21, P23) to a pure CoCrFeNi matrix, which is a new alloy system for this intervention. It also integrates the concept of adaptive tribolayer formation from NiX CCA (P7, P8, P9) and reactive wear protection (P10, P15, P16) into a single mechanism, linking lattice distortion to a temperature-dependent lubrication transition that none of the passages explicitly states for this matrix. This combination of a transferred intervention with a synthesized mechanism from multiple sources goes beyond a simple copy.
